summary: Davao del Sur representative with 179 principal-authored bills. Authored 4Ps expansion, tertiary-education subsidy, a national land use commission and a nutrition program, alongside travel-tax abolition and presidential power to suspend fuel excise. Also authored workplace discrimination and technology-facilitated violence bills and an anti-dynasty ban.
caveat: Gender-equality bills form one issue, so social values are unscored. Many other bills unreviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored 4Ps expansion (-3), expanded tertiary subsidy (-2) and national land use policy (-1), against travel-tax abolition and presidential fuel-excise suspension (+2). Redistributive social spending outweighs tax cuts.
